decision.reason: [ev-30d2c387f95f] is a single release-note line. It says the Vault issuer gains an optional setting for the server-name used to validate the certificates the Vault server presents, so the change type (added) is clear. It does not name the API group, kind or field path of the new setting, so the subject cannot be written as a typed assertion. Without that path, an applicability condition cannot be spelled either. The line only points to PR #7663, so the schema/CRD diff or the PR content is needed to settle the open aspects.
